verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, so neither is the better resize. Both have the same flaws: the quote leaves 'soon.' alone on the last line; 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' sits right under the quote, runs almost to the right edge and is too small to read in a skyscraper; and a large empty band is left between the attribution and the circle. In both, the logo sits on the purple circle just below the small can, which crowds that area. The only visible difference is that B's logo is slightly smaller and lighter, which doesn't matter much either way.
